Yes, there are four-berth cabins left. How many of you are travelling?

messages.content: Can I buy two tickets for the derby on the 20th?
The derby is members-only priority this week. Are you a member?
no
Then general sale opens on Monday at 10am.
How much is membership, and would it let me buy now?
It's £35 a year and gives you access to priority sales straight away.
ok sign me up
Done, your membership number is 778120.
Can I get my son's new shirt printed with his name before the game?

messages.content: My dad uses a wheelchair, can we get seats together for Saturday?
Yes, there are wheelchair bays with a carer seat in the east stand. Shall I book them?
yes please
Booked, and the carer ticket is free.
is there accessible parking near the east stand?
Yes, I've added a blue badge space.
We'd also love to do the stadium tour on Sunday morning.
The 10am tour has space, it's fully accessible.
Last time some fans were throwing things near the bays, who can I tell?
